name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz’s passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, captivated by the vibrant liveries and intricate designs adorning racing cars. He pursued this fascination through vocational training, specializing in automotive painting and design. Eager to combine his artistic talent with his love for racing, Deniz sought an opportunity in motorsport, landing a junior role at a small tuning shop. He quickly demonstrated a knack for color matching and precise application techniques.

He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his eagerness to experiment with new painting technologies. Deniz thrives on the challenge of bringing complex design concepts to life. While he may be relatively new to the professional scene, his dedication and innovative ideas make him a valuable asset to any team looking to push the boundaries of visual presentation and aerodynamic performance.

Though quiet and reserved, Deniz possesses a strong desire to contribute significantly to a winning team. His ambition is to become a leading figure in motorsport aesthetics, recognized for his creativity and technical expertise.

physical.description: Deniz is of average height with a wiry build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Keeps a detailed sketchbook filled with livery ideas and color palettes.
Obsessively cleans his paint gun after every use, regardless of how small the job was.
